mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_preference (user_id, age, gender, travel_companions, cold_sensitivity, heat_sensitivity, health_issues, packing_style, updated_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{age}, #{gender}, #{travelCompanions}, #{coldSensitivity}, #{heatSensitivity}, #{healthIssues}, #{packingStyle}, #{updatedTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_preference WHERE user_id = #{userId}
